title: Rain

time_convention.t: seconds from segment start, rounded to 0.01 s
time_convention.abs: seconds from the beginning of the song, rounded to 0.01 s

loudness.method: RMS (2048 samples, hop 256) -> 0.5 s smoothing; sustained step >= 2.5 dB comparing 0.40 s before/after, min 1.0 s apart; first/last 0.6 s ignored
loudness.note: changes are sustained mix-level steps (>=2.5 dB, >=1 s apart); single drum hits / short transients are intentionally not listed here

notes_zh: t 是相对所选片段起点的秒数，abs 是相对歌曲开头的秒数；所有时间四舍五入到 0.01 s。
beat 是节拍脉冲（librosa beat_track, tightness=400）；onset 是瞬态起始；drum_onsets 是 HPSS 打击乐分量上的 onset。
音量突变只列持续型平均电平变化（0.5 s 平滑，前后 0.40 s 比较，>=2.5 dB），鼓点造成的瞬时 RMS 尖峰不算。
纯音乐：Demucs/ASR/WhisperX 全部跳过；vocals 字段保留为空结构。

structure.label_method: short fragments merged toward >= min_segment_sec; first short section= intro; last short quiet section= outro; late repeated high-energy cluster= chorus; early repeated / longest clusters= verse; unique mid low-energy cluster= bridge; remaining by energy vs segment median
structure.label_note: Labels are heuristic from audio structure, not ground truth.

allin1.reason: allin1 is optional (pip install allin1, plus NATTEN and madmom). On Windows it cannot be installed today: NATTEN ships no Windows wheels and madmom's source build fails, so librosa laplacian segmentation is used instead.

notes: librosa 1.0 removed laplacian_segmentation; implemented from the official librosa example (CQT + recurrence + normalized Laplacian + KMeans).

energy.method: RMS dBFS over the beat-to-next-beat window

density.method: onsets per 4-beat bar (4/4 assumed; first beat = bar start)
